fields.subject: Expression Debug View
fields.condition: the visited expression node constructs an object, an array, or a member-initializer binding
fields.response: render a constructor call as `.New Type` followed by a parenthesized argument list; render an array node as `.NewArray ElementType` followed by a bracketed bound list for a bounds-specified array or as `.NewArray ArrayType` followed by a braced item list for an array literal; render a member-init node as the rendering of its `new` expression followed by a braced list of its bindings; render a list-init element as the rendering of its single argument or, for more than one argument, a braced argument list; and render a member assignment or a list/member sub-binding as `MemberName = ` followed by the rendering of its assigned value or, for a sub-binding, a braced list of its own bindings or initializers
